App Crash.identify_when: App crashes, closes unexpectedly, or freezes
App Crash.solution: Investigate crash logs, reproduce issue, and release fix
App Crash.not_confuse_with: Transaction Failure (Use App Crash if app closes/crashes even during transaction)

App Not Opening.identify_when: App does not launch or start

App Slow/Performance.identify_when: App is slow, lagging, or taking too long to load screens
App Slow/Performance.solution: Investigate performance bottlenecks and optimize app responsiveness

Login Issue.identify_when: Customer cannot log into app or authentication fails
Login Issue.solution: Investigate authentication and login service failures

OTP Issue.identify_when: OTP not received, invalid, or delayed
OTP Issue.solution: Check OTP delivery service and authentication gateway

Transaction Failure.identify_when: App stays open but money transfer or transaction fails to complete
Transaction Failure.not_confuse_with: App Crash (If app closes/crashes, use App Crash instead)

Duplicate Deduction.identify_when: Money deducted twice for single transaction or invoice
Duplicate Deduction.solution: Verify duplicate transaction and process refund if confirmed

Failed Transaction.identify_when: Payment or transaction failed to process
Failed Transaction.solution: Investigate transaction failure details and status

Pending Transaction.solution: Check transaction status and process resolution

Unauthorized Transaction.identify_when: Customer denies making or authorizing transaction

Refund Issue.identify_when: Customer complains refund is missing, delayed, or not processed
Refund Issue.solution: Check refund status and expedite processing

Billing Error.identify_when: Incorrect billing, fee calculation error, or wrong charge
Billing Error.solution: Verify billing records and adjust charges if confirmed

Incorrect Amount.identify_when: Charged wrong amount on invoice or bill
Incorrect Amount.solution: Investigate deduction details and correct discrepancy

Verification Delay.identify_when: Loan application verification is pending, delayed, or taking weeks without update
Verification Delay.solution: Investigate verification workflow and provide application status update to customer
Verification Delay.not_confuse_with: Documentation Issues (Use Documentation Issues only if specific documents are missing or rejected)

Documentation Issues.identify_when: Problem with required loan documents, missing documents, or document rejection
Documentation Issues.solution: Identify required missing documents and request submission
Documentation Issues.not_confuse_with: Verification Delay (Use Verification Delay if verification is taking long without document rejection)

Approval Delay.identify_when: Loan approval taking longer than expected time
Approval Delay.solution: Investigate approval stage and clear backlog

Disbursement Delay.identify_when: Loan approved but money not disbursed to account
Disbursement Delay.solution: Investigate disbursement pipeline and release funds

Mobile & Email Update.identify_when: Customer asks or complains about updating registered mobile number or email address
Mobile & Email Update.solution: Provide clear instructions for updating registered contact details via self-service portal
Mobile & Email Update.not_confuse_with: Web Portal (Primary issue is Mobile & Email Update, not generic Web Portal)

Account Access.identify_when: Unable to access profile or account details
Account Access.solution: Investigate account access permissions and guide user

Unhelpful Agent.identify_when: Representative was unhelpful, provided poor service quality, or failed to assist
Unhelpful Agent.solution: Review interaction logs and provide coaching to representative

Helpful & Professional Agent.identify_when: Agent was polite, patient, helpful, or resolved issue quickly
Helpful & Professional Agent.solution: Recognize and reinforce agent's exemplary customer handling behavior
Helpful & Professional Agent.not_confuse_with: Assign Low Priority to positive praise!

Response Time.identify_when: Customer complains or praises speed of query response or turnaround time
Response Time.solution: Maintain fast turnaround time and improve response standards
Response Time.not_confuse_with: Delivery Experience or Accessibility (Use Response Time for query turnaround)

Call Disconnect.identify_when: Call disconnected unexpectedly during support call
Call Disconnect.solution: Investigate call network and follow up with customer

Aggressive Behaviour.identify_when: Agent spoke in rude, aggressive tone or abruptly hung up on call
Aggressive Behaviour.solution: Review call recording, investigate abrupt termination, and coach agent on professional communication
Aggressive Behaviour.not_confuse_with: Notifications (Do NOT confuse aggressive tone or hung-up calls with Notifications!)

Rude Behaviour.solution: Review interaction recording and initiate coaching

Fraudulent Activity.identify_when: Customer alleges fraud, scam, or threatens police complaint / RBI ombudsman
Fraudulent Activity.solution: Investigate allegation promptly, preserve records, and route to compliance/fraud team
Fraudulent Activity.not_confuse_with: Never state fraud as confirmed fact! Use 'alleges fraudulent activity'.
